records.title: Ripple expands strategic digital-assets collaboration with BNY across custody and tokenized trade finance
records.summary: BNY states that its Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD. BNY reiterates its role as primary RLUSD reserve custodian and existing custody relationship with Ripple Prime. It intends, subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals, to broaden support for XRPL-issued tokenized assets and enable BNY clients to mint/redeem RLUSD through BNY. Ripple and BNY are exploring a C2FO supply-chain-finance initiative using XRPL.
records.methodology: Official BNY newsroom announcement dated October 27, 2026.
records.limitations: Does not disclose XRP or RLUSD assets under custody, client balances, proprietary holdings, actual mint/redeem volume or production trade-finance volume. Future initiatives are explicitly subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals.

records.publisher: Ripple, distributed via Business Wire and Nasdaq
records.title: Ripple and Robinhood partner to power the next generation of finance
records.summary: The announcement says RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood, is expected later in the Robinhood app, and will be used on XRPL for institutional settlement. Robinhood plans to integrate Ripple Treasury. Ripple Prime provides Bitstamp by Robinhood with lending and margin financing across roughly 20 digital assets and gives Ripple Prime clients spot access to Bitstamp; perpetual futures support is planned later.
records.methodology: Ripple press release distributed by Business Wire and reproduced by Nasdaq; the page identifies Ripple as source.
records.limitations: No XRPL settlement volume, transaction count, unique counterparties, XRP bridge usage or XRP inventory is disclosed. The roughly 20 financed assets are not enumerated; XRP inclusion is not established. Robinhood-app availability and later perpetual-futures support were prospective at publication.

records.title: RLUSD is now available on Coinbase
records.summary: Coinbase announced RLUSD availability through Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and the Coinbase retail app in supported regions. At launch, customers could deposit and withdraw RLUSD on XRPL, Base and Ethereum and convert USD to RLUSD at 1:1. Coinbase Global Exchange availability, including using RLUSD as collateral, was stated as a later follow-on. Ripple said it would provide liquidity on Base.
records.methodology: Official Coinbase product blog, dated October 28, 2026.
records.limitations: The announcement does not disclose RLUSD trading volume, net inflows, market-maker inventory or the date Global Exchange collateral support becomes active. Do not describe collateral support as live at launch.

records.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 earnings highlights
records.summary: Coinbase reported Q3 crypto trading-volume market share of 10.7%, its fourth consecutive quarter of gains; assets on platform at 12.5% of total crypto market capitalization; average USDC held in Coinbase products of $22B; subscription and services revenue at 49% of net revenue; crypto derivatives trading volume compound annual growth of 179% over two years; and prediction markets above $200M annualized revenue.
records.methodology: Coinbase Q3 2026 investor-relations earnings release, company-reported metrics.
records.limitations: These are company-reported quarterly measures and not independent estimates. Average USDC held is a quarterly average, not a current end-of-day balance. The reported share of USDC economics is company-described and does not identify all counterparties or transaction-level cash flows.

records.title: Coinbase adds Ripple's stablecoin to its exchange
records.summary: Reuters independently reported Coinbase's addition of RLUSD across retail and institutional platforms and described the move as an expansion of Coinbase's dollar-stablecoin slate. It noted Coinbase's historical USDC flagship relationship and its subsequent addition of PYUSD and OpenUSD.
records.methodology: Reuters report by Hannah Lang, October 28, 2026.
records.limitations: The report does not establish that Coinbase ended or reduced its Circle USDC distribution relationship. It is not a source for RLUSD transaction volume or XRP demand.

records.title: Main commit 13be82b — Cross-analysis refresh
records.summary: Current main commit 13be82b changes only the generated_at timestamp in ping-pongings/knowledge-base/sentiment_shift.json from 07:51:51Z to 08:51:34Z. The XRP and BTC recent/prior sentiment windows remain null with zero entries. No workflow run was returned as associated with this exact commit.
records.methodology: Read-only GitHub commit and file inspection.
records.limitations: The commit message and path match the scheduled Cross Analysis writer pattern, but exact workflow-run attribution for this commit is not established by the returned run association.

records.title: Open pull-request inventory at 2026-10-31T09:05Z
records.summary: Two pages of the GitHub open-pull-request endpoint returned 176 open PRs: 166 drafts and 10 ready for review; 174 target main and 2 target non-main branches. Main was 13be82b, and none of the 174 main-based PRs used that exact base SHA at the inventory cutoff.
records.methodology: GitHub REST pulls endpoint, state=open, per_page=100, pages 1 and 2; counts computed from returned base SHA and draft fields.
records.limitations: Inventory is a point-in-time snapshot. Base SHA drift changes as main advances; this does not imply every stale PR is merge-conflicting or unsafe.

records.title: PR #1400 fixed-horizon forecast ledger with append-lock correction
records.summary: PR #1400 head 5f3ac524 adds a fixed-horizon forecast/outcome ledger with optional source-registry checks, 120-second default issue-price freshness guard, append-only records, probability metrics and OS-level locking for consistent reads/writes and duplicate-ID prevention. It remains open, draft and unmerged; its base is b28f43c and current main 13be82b is two commits ahead of that base.
records.methodology: Read-only PR metadata and exact-head compare against current main; branch updated through non-force fast-forward commits with expected-head checks.
records.limitations: This is a ledger, not a trained model. Walk-forward training, calibrated predictive skill, drift detection, distributed locking and shadow evaluation are not implemented.

records.title: PR #1400 exact-head CI run 41187141721
records.summary: The exact PR #1400 head 5f3ac524 passed CI with 371 tests and 8 subtests, including the concurrent duplicate-ID append regression test.
records.methodology: GitHub Actions run and job log inspection.
records.limitations: CI success does not validate predictive skill or distributed/network-filesystem lock semantics.

records.title: PR #1400 fail-closed gate run 41187141804

records.limitations: Gate pass is not merge approval and does not mean the PR was merged.

records.title: PR #1401 read-only Cross Analysis proposal
records.summary: PR #1401 proposes removing scheduled Cross Analysis writes to main and emitting artifacts instead. Its exact-head CI passed 345 tests plus 8 subtests and its fail-closed gate passed. It remains draft/unmerged and its base b90e600 is one main commit behind current main.
records.methodology: PR metadata, compare endpoint and linked exact-head CI/gate inspection.
records.limitations: Artifact-only output does not preserve the current tracked-file/Pages refresh behavior. Merge would require a separately reviewed publication design.

records.title: PR #1402 approval workflow push no-op proposal
records.summary: PR #1402 adds an explicit push-event no-op with zero permissions and scopes approval permissions to manual workflow_dispatch. Exact-head CI passed 342 tests plus 8 subtests, its gate passed, and the tested push no-op job succeeded while approval was skipped. Manual workflow_dispatch approval was not tested. The PR remains draft/unmerged and is one main commit behind current main.
records.methodology: PR metadata, workflow diff and linked push/CI/gate run inspection.
records.limitations: The root cause of prior zero-job push events is not conclusively established. The manual approval path and permissions have not been exercised on a controlled test PR.

records.title: PR #1398 Databricks token-input workflow safety proposal
records.summary: PR #1398 removes the new_token workflow-dispatch input, shell interpolation, secret mutation and deployment dispatch, replacing them with a zero-permission ROTATION_NOT_PERFORMED diagnostic. Exact-head CI passed 344 tests plus 8 subtests and its gate passed. It remains draft/unmerged; current main still contains the unsafe workflow.
records.methodology: PR metadata, workflow diff, regression tests and exact-head CI/gate inspection.
records.limitations: The remediation is not active on main. The branch is three commits behind current main; no token was read or rotated and no deployment was performed.
